# Sponsor logo sources

Downloaded on 7 November 2026. These SVGs are unchanged official assets, served locally so displaying a provider does not depend on its website.

| File | Official source | Asset use on the source website |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `gladia.svg` | https://www.gladia.io/favicon.svg | Compact Gladia symbol, black rounded tile |
| `linkup.svg` | https://www.linkup.so/_next/static/immutable/media/logo-mark.0ik9azgcc90iz.svg | Compact Linkup navigation mark |
| `stripe.svg` | https://images.stripeassets.com/fzn2n1nzq965/1hgcBNd12BfT9VLgbId7By/01d91920114b124fb4cf6d448f9f06eb/favicon.svg | Official Stripe favicon linked by https://stripe.com/ |
| `devin.svg` | https://devin.ai/favicon.svg | Compact Cognition mark used by Devin |

Each source is linked by its provider’s public home page: https://www.gladia.io/, https://www.linkup.so/, and https://devin.ai/. Logo geometry, view boxes and colors are preserved.

The H Company mark is already available at `/static/h-kit/h-logo-black.svg`; it comes from the official H Company press pack at https://hcompany.ai/press.

The event archive lists H Company and 42AI as organizers, with support from Gladia, Linkup, Cognition (Devin), Stripe, and Morning (`event-data/luma-page-text.txt`). Only providers referenced by this interface receive assets here.
